Turnkey · Indore

BANGER

A bar in Indore built like a great hall: vaulted brick ceilings, gothic arches and a wall of glowing lamps, all bathed in amber light.

Location
Indore
Venue
Bar & lounge
Scope
Turnkey: design & execution
Spaces
Great hall, bar & entrance
The project

Old-world drama, turned up loud.

BANGER borrows the grandeur of a medieval hall: brick barrel vaults overhead, pointed arches along the walls and chandeliers hanging down the length of the room.

Every surface carries detail, from carved panels and knight figures to a stained-glass bar and a wall alive with sconces, so the room feels rich and immersive from every seat.

Inside BANGER

Space by space

The great hall

Rows of timber tables and leather seating run beneath the brick vaults, framed by gothic arches and a glowing back wall.

The lamp wall

A carved wall layered with sconces, ornaments and sculpted figures gives the hall its warm, theatrical glow.

The bar

A backlit bar sits within stained-glass arches and patterned panels, with a reflective counter that doubles the light.

The entrance

A carved timber doorway and illuminated signage set the tone before guests even step inside.
